text:
This solution, National Seismic Hazard Assessment of Papua New Guinea (NSHA-PNG), 
National Probabilistic Seismic Hazard Assessment for Papua New Guinea (2019 Revision, PSHA19), 
Interim Amendment to PNGS 1001-1982: Part 4: Earthquake Design Actions addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Papua New Guinea between Geoscience Australia, King Consultants, and Beca. The program was implemented in 2018-2019, 
2020, 
2023 and focuses on collaboration, regulation, and raising awareness.
